newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-EESTI 97 H1 NET PROFIT 7.6MLN EEK.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-EESTI 97 H1 NET PROFIT 7.6MLN EEK.

text.p: Eesti Naitus, a fair and exhibition company, said on Wednesday that its first half-year net profit was 7.6 million kroons.
In a statement the company said that its net profit was 6.2 times greater compared to the same period in the previous year.
The exhibition company's turnover was 1.8 times greater than the same period of 1996 and was 57.1 percent of their forecast for 1997.
The balance sheet volume at the end of June was 96.5 million kroons, an increase of 2.3 times compared to the same period in the previous year.
Reserves grew by 19.6 million kroons to 53.1 million kroons from the beginning of the year. --David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom +372 620 9201/2 reuters@reuters.ee
